title: 1995 AMC 8 Problem 22
statement: The number \(6545\) can be written as a product of a pair of positive two-digit numbers. What is the sum of this pair of numbers?

solutions.text:
The prime factorization is \(6545 = 5 \times 7 \times 11 \times 17.\) To split into two two-digit factors, pair the primes: \(5 \times 17 = 85\) and \(7 \times 11 = 77.\)

These are the only two-digit pair, and their sum is \(85 + 77 = 162.\)

Thus, the correct answer is A .
hints: Group the prime factors into two numbers that are each between \(10\) and \(99\)
